blocks.text: Precision Neurotoxin Injections for Fine Line & Wrinkle Correction
blocks.html: Precision Neurotoxin Injections for Fine Line & Wrinkle Correction

Discover the transformative power of neurotoxin treatments, a safe, effective, and minimally invasive solution for temporarily smoothing away dynamic wrinkles – those lines that appear when you frown, squint, or raise your eyebrows. At our Calgary clinic, our expertly administered neurotoxin injections can soften forehead lines, diminish crow's feet around the eyes, and ease those tell-tale lines between your brows, revealing a refreshed and more youthful appearance.

blocks.text: Why Choose Neurotoxin Treatments at Our Clinic?
blocks.html: Why Choose Neurotoxin Treatments at Our Clinic?

Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. All our neurotoxin treatments are exclusively performed by our highly skilled and experienced Registered Nurse Injectors, ensuring the highest standards of care and precision. Furthermore, every treatment is overseen by our dedicated Medical Director, providing you with complete peace of mind knowing you are in the hands of qualified professionals.
Neurotoxins are a versatile treatment for addressing various signs of facial aging:

items: Forehead Lines: Smooth out those horizontal lines that can make you look worried or tired.
Glabellar Lines (Frown Lines): Soften the vertical lines between your eyebrows, often referred to as the "elevens," that can convey stress or frustration.
Crow's Feet: Minimize the fine lines that radiate from the corners of your eyes, helping you look brighter and more youthful.

Lower Face: Precisely administered neurotoxin injections in the lower face can subtly lift and enhance the jawline, increasing definition. They can also address concerns like downturned marionette (smile) lines.
Beyond Wrinkles: Neurotoxins can also be used for other concerns such as brow lifts, softening bunny lines on the nose, and addressing a gummy smile (upon consultation).

blocks.html: Our neurotoxin treatments are quick and relatively comfortable, with most appointments taking 30 minutes. You may experience a few tiny pinpricks during the injections, but any discomfort is typically minimal and short-lived. There is little to no downtime, allowing you to return to your daily activities almost immediately. You can typically start to see the smoothing effects within 7 days, with full results visible around the two week mark. The effects typically last for 3-4 months, and regular treatments can help maintain your refreshed appearance.

blocks.text: Personalized Treatment Plans for Optimal Results:

blocks.html: Our Registered Nurse Injectors will take the time to understand your individual concerns and desired outcomes during a thorough consultation. They will develop a personalized treatment plan tailored to your unique facial anatomy and aesthetic goals, ensuring natural-looking results that enhance your existing features without looking fake or unnatural.

blocks.text: Enhance Your Natural Beauty with Expert Lip Filler Treatments in Calgary
blocks.html: Enhance Your Natural Beauty with Expert Lip Filler Treatments in Calgary

Dreaming of fuller, more defined, or beautifully balanced lips? Lip filler treatments offer a wonderful and versatile solution to subtly enhance your natural lip shape and volume. Whether you desire a more pronounced pout, improved symmetry, or a boost in hydration and definition, our expertly administered lip filler treatments at our Calgary clinic can help you achieve your desired look with natural-looking results.

blocks.text: Why Choose Lip Fillers at Our Clinic?
blocks.html: Why Choose Lip Fillers at Our Clinic?

Your comfort and safety are paramount. All our lip filler treatments are exclusively performed by our highly skilled and experienced Registered Nurse Injector. With an artistic eye and a thorough understanding of facial anatomy, our injector is dedicated to providing you with beautiful, natural-looking enhancement that complements your unique features. We prioritize a personalized approach to ensure your goals are understood and achieved with precision and care.
Lip filler treatments are a versatile way to address a variety of concerns and aesthetic goals:

items: Enhance Volume: Add subtle or more noticeable plumpness to thin lips.
Define the Lip Border: Create a more distinct and youthful vermilion border (the outline of your lips).
Improve Symmetry: Correct minor imbalances in lip size and shape.
Smooth Vertical Lip Lines: Soften those fine lines that can appear above the upper lip.
Enhance the Cupid's Bow: Create a more defined and attractive "V" shape in the center of your upper lip.
Boost Hydration: Improve lip texture and reduce dryness for a softer, more supple appearance.
Create a More Balanced Profile: Enhance the overall harmony of your facial features.

blocks.html: At our clinic, we believe in a personalized approach to lip enhancement. During your consultation, our Registered Nurse Injector will take the time to listen to your aesthetic goals, assess your natural lip shape and facial structure, and discuss the best treatment options to achieve your desired outcome. We will explain the different types of fillers available and recommend the most suitable product to create the natural-looking volume and definition you desire.

blocks.text: What to Expect During Your Treatment:

blocks.html: Lip filler treatments are typically quick and relatively comfortable. We use premium dermal fillers composed of hyaluronic acid, a naturally occurring substance in the body. To ensure your comfort, a topical numbing cream is applied before the injections. The filler is then carefully and strategically injected into specific areas of your lips using fine needles or cannulas. The procedure usually takes approximately 30 to 45 minutes. Some mild swelling or bruising is common immediately after treatment but typically subsides within a few days.

Ready to explore the possibilities of lip enhancement? Call the clinic at (403) 454-5607 or schedule an injectables consultation on our online booking site . Our skilled Registered Nurse Injector is dedicated to helping you achieve the beautifully enhanced and natural-looking lips you've always wanted.
Pairs well with: Dermaplaning, LED lights, any of our facials, Radiofrequency Skin Tightening, Non-Invasive Facelift, RF Microneedling & IPL treatments

blocks.text: Restore Volume & Smooth Lines with HA Dermal Fillers
blocks.html: Restore Volume & Smooth Lines with HA Dermal Fillers

Rediscover a more youthful and refreshed version of yourself with our expertly administered dermal filler treatments, available at our Calgary clinic. Dermal fillers are a versatile and effective solution for addressing a range of age-related concerns, from softening the appearance of wrinkles and facial creases to restoring lost volume and enhancing your natural facial contours. Our skilled practitioners use premium hyaluronic acid-based fillers to subtly rejuvenate your appearance, leaving you looking and feeling your best.

blocks.text: Unlock Natural Rejuvenation with Dermal Fillers:

blocks.html: Dermal fillers are a fantastic option for targeting various areas of the face, providing natural-looking enhancement and rejuvenation:

items: Smooth Wrinkles & Lines: Effectively soften the appearance of fine lines, moderate wrinkles, and deeper facial creases, such as smile lines (nasolabial folds) and marionette lines.
Restore Lost Volume: Replenish volume in areas that have become hollow or sunken with age, such as the cheeks and temples, providing a more youthful and lifted appearance.
Enhance Facial Contours: Define and sculpt features like the cheeks, jawline, and chin, creating greater balance and definition.
Brighten Under Eyes: Gently fill hollows and soften the appearance of dark circles and under-eye bags, resulting in a more rested and refreshed look.

blocks.text: Targeted Treatments for Your Unique Needs:

blocks.html: Our experienced practitioners utilize a variety of advanced injection techniques and premium dermal filler products to address specific areas of concern:

items: Temples: Restore lost volume in the temples to address hollowing and provide subtle upper facial support.
Cheeks: Enhance volume and lift in the midface for a more youthful and contoured appearance.
Nasolabial Folds (Smile Lines): Soften the lines that run from the nose to the corners of the mouth.
Marionette Lines (Chin Shadow): Reduce the lines that run from the corners of the mouth down to the chin, addressing a common sign of aging.
Chin: Add definition and projection to the chin, improving facial balance and harmony.
Jawline: Create a more defined and sculpted jawline, enhancing the lower facial structure.
Under Eyes (Tear Troughs): Gently fill hollows to reduce the appearance of dark circles and create a smoother transition between the lower eyelid and cheek.

blocks.html: We believe in transparency and want to provide you with a general understanding of our dermal filler pricing. Please note that the exact amount of filler required will vary depending on individual anatomy, desired outcome, and the severity of the concern.

items: Temples: Typically 0.5 to 1 syringe per side - $375 to $650 per side
Cheeks: Typically 0.5 to 1 syringe per side - $375 to $650 per side
Nasolabial Folds / Smile Lines: Typically 0.5 to 1 syringe per side - $375 to $650 per side
Marionette Lines / Chin Shadow: Typically 0.5 to 1 syringe total - $375 to $650
Chin: Typically 0.5 to 1 syringe total - $375 to $650
Jawline: Typically 1 to 2 syringes per side - $650 to $1300 per side
Under Eyes (Tear Troughs): Typically 0.5 to 1 syringe total - $375 to $650
